HIEROGLYPHS AND LOGARITHMS

Three guardians protect the entrance to the secret chambers. Every door opens only to those who know the properties of logarithms: definition, product, quotient, and power.

Grab paper and pen and solve every puzzle in each chamber, and Thoth's treasure will be yours.

Properties of Logarithms

Definition
loga(b) = c     ab = c
Product

Quotient

Power
